population.rule: A Stage-0 record is eligible iff its RecordKey appears in the train-or-validation view of EVERY supplied manifest; a record whose physical key is in ANY supplied manifest's test partition is excluded, with the exclusion counted and attributed as test_under_<label>.

tolerance_derivation: numerical_tolerance = tolerance_floor + tolerance_fp32_increment, where tolerance_floor = max(positive_control_median_residual, provenance_control_median_residual) under the shared qualifying-snapshot mask and tolerance_fp32_increment = max(0.0, measured fp32-cast-then-float64-restored provenance-control median residual increase). No safety multiplier, population-fitted percentile, imported physics threshold, Phase 38 threshold, or theory-predicted ~21x / ~99x separation enters (GAP-46-03 Option A guardrails 1-3).
